ns2:course.label: Natural Disasters
ns2:course.description: Introduces the nature, causes, risks, effects, and prediction of natural disasters including earthquakes, volcanoes, landslides, subsidence, global climate change, severe weather, coastal erosion, floods, mass extinctions, and meteorite impacts; covers scientific principles and case histories of natural disasters as well as human responses (societal impact, mitigation strategies, and public policy). Same as ESE 118 and GLBL 118.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Nat Sci & Tech - Phys Sciences course.
